name: Sentinel
author: Luis Tav
description: Watches your AI coding agents for bypass flags, hook tampering, and surprise shells; approve, kill, or investigate from the bar.

barWidget.description: Open-alert count in the bar and a panel that lists what your coding agents did that changed the shape of a session: bypass flags, hook or settings writes, surprise shells. Approve with a scope, kill the child, investigate, or dismiss. Installs and manages the Sentinel daemon.

schema.label: sentinel-action path
schema.description: Optional. Absolute path to sentinel-action. Empty means resolve it from PATH.
